description: This Java class, AuditService, provides logging functionalities for audit entries related to CRUD operations. It interacts with an AuditLogRepository to persist logs capturing user actions, timestamps, and states before and after modifications.

classes.name: AuditService
classes.description: Service class responsible for creating and saving audit log entries for user actions on notes.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Persists an audit log entry with user ID, action, note ID, timestamps, states before/after, path, and reason.

methods.name: logCreate
methods.description: Shortcut to log creation actions, sets action as 'CREATE'.

methods.name: logUpdate
methods.description: Shortcut to log update actions, including before and after states.

methods.name: logDelete
methods.description: Shortcut to log delete actions, including before state.
